cards.name: Footwork
cards.text: Advance or Withdraw one space, then draw one card.

cards.name: Cull
cards.text: Trash Cull and one card from hand, or two cards from hand.

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: At Close range, give the opponent Exposed.

cards.name: Drive
cards.text: At Close range, deal 2 damage, then push and follow. A wall collision deals 2 additional damage.

cards.name: Flurry
cards.text: Deal 1 damage for each other Action played this turn, to a maximum of 5.

cards.name: Vault
cards.text: At Close range, jump over the opponent into the empty space beyond, then draw one card.

cards.name: Aim
cards.text: At Mid or Far range, become Aimed, then draw one card.

cards.name: Volley
cards.text: Deal 2 damage at Mid range or 5 damage at Far range. Aimed changes this to 5 or 7.
